test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'POKER' is written as 'IHDXK' and 'FANDS' is written as 'YTGWL'. How will 'AQBCG' be written in that code language?
solution:
The position of the English alphabet letters is given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af7f5248a0c6050307cf17b8c83db8e491536f519fe8ba8a2eb262575c9e9f06.png] 

'POKER' is written as 'IHDXK' 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10c1d1c35931b31f55b6b23c0f41a156b7c2eb5724a515680893dc3178694249.png] 

And,

'FANDS' is written as 'YTGWL'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9802ef2f2fe7ce2a6669c0702169372f67e1ce048baebf59f73b606a94a2948b.png] 

Similarly,

'AQBCG' be written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47374bd98b673456e25ec00df7f42ec0a55d04db5de0ca3770d7c963f7442b7f.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"TJUVZ".**
